public_rationale: The records show both an acceleration policy and an actual temporary safety pause at OpenAI. The pause matters and prevents treating all activity as uninterrupted. Under the collective-deployment reading, however, it is not the societal shutdown or suspension described in the passage. No qualifying conclusive event was established. With no deadline, continued deployment cannot settle the prediction in Marcus's favor.
limitations: The result depends on the scope assigned to society and some applications.
A broader reading that includes individual research pauses would make the OpenAI evidence substantially more adverse.
The source-type vocabulary has no government-policy category; the White House item is an official policy disclosure, not a company statement.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Society will almost certainly not shut down or pause LLMs to wait for safety solutions.

statement.excerpt: Given how much money is at stake, and all the fear, uncertainty and doubt about China possibly eclipsing us in the race to build the world’s most perfect text completion system, I estimate the probability of society pursuing the option of patiently waiting for solutions to be barely indistinguishable from zero.
statement.document_title: LLMs: Dishonest, unpredictable and potentially dangerous.

from_speaker: society pursuing the option of patiently waiting for solutions
shut LLMs down (or at least some applications of them)

our_interpretation: The plain reading is a prediction against a collective policy of suspending LLM deployment, or a major class of applications, pending safety remedies.
A government or coordinated industry decision could constitute society choosing this option. A temporary internal pause at one developer is relevant but does not automatically meet that scope.
The probability language is treated as a directional forecast. One realized outcome cannot establish whether a near-zero probability estimate was well calibrated.
criteria.support_condition: Continued deployment without a qualifying pause is consistent with the prediction, but cannot conclusively establish an indefinite negative forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A government or coordinated industry body implements a substantial suspension of LLM deployment or a major application class explicitly pending safety solutions.
